text: dsh-codex-runner 是面向 DSH Web 的插件，把本机 Codex CLI 接入当前项目工作区。它注册任务运行、状态查询、追加指令、取消和额度查看等工具，并可在后台运行任务、查看输出与管理设置。适合希望让 DSH 协调 Codex 完成项目工作的开发者；运行需要 Windows、本机已安装并登录的 Codex CLI。

dsh-codex-runner connects local Codex CLI to a DSH Web workspace. Start project tasks, track status, send follow-up instructions, cancel runs, and check quota. Long runs can continue in the background. Requires Windows and an installed, authenticated Codex CLI.
想让 DSH 把当前项目任务交给本机 Codex 执行，并能继续查看结果。
Codex 任务运行时间很长时，怎么在后台跟踪进度并追加要求？
How can I start a Codex task from DSH and check or control it later by run ID?
dsh-codex-runner 的功能「运行与管理 Codex 任务」：通过 DSH 工具在当前工作区启动 Codex 任务，并返回运行信息；可继续查询状态、发送后续指令或取消运行。
dsh-codex-runner 的功能「查看额度与诊断运行」：额度工具读取账号额度和重置信息，诊断工具查看单个运行的状态及额度证据；可选探测会发送一次明确的 steer。

dsh-codex-runner README · dsh-codex-runner：**dsh-codex-runner** 是面向 Windows 的 DSH 插件，让 DSH 调用本机 Codex CLI 完成项目任务，并管理执行过程与结果。Codex 使用你的本地工作区和已有登录，DSH 负责规划、复查和后续推进

dsh-codex-runner README · 可以做什么：| 你想做的事 | 插件提供的能力 |
| --- | --- |
| 把项目任务交给 Codex | 在当前工作区启动任务，返回完整最终答复 |
| 运行耗时任务 | 支持后台执行，DSH 重启后仍可按运行 ID 查询或取消 |
| 执行中补充要求 | 向当前轮发送指令、中断当前轮，或排队追加下一轮 |
| 查看进展与历史 | 查询执行状态、账号额度和当前工作区的关联会话 |
| 在执行期间查看输出 | 两种后端在主聊天区显示正文与可展开操作，单纯显示不调用模型 |
| 让 DSH 主动监督 | 分批读取进度、处理原请求问答，并按已有授权调整同一任务 |
| 管理权限与配置 | 原生设置页、完整配置编辑器和可编辑的字段注册表 |
| 按需启用增强功能 | 低额度暂停、额度恢复续跑和定时状态报告，明确说明额外 token 开销 |
dsh-codex-runner README · 可以做什么：实时显示与主动监督默认均开启，可分别关闭。App Server 与 exec 两种后端将已完成的消息和操作显示为独立聊天记录，支持断线后补读；任务结束并读完输出后停止持续查询。单纯显示不调用模型，主动监督消耗 DSH 模型 token，并在宿主可用时让新任务自动后台运行。详见[运行说明](docs/runtime.md)。

dsh-codex-runner README · 下载与安装：需要 **Windows、DSH，以及已安装并登录的 Codex CLI**。Node 最低版本为 `22.23.4`，已验证 `22.23.4` 和 `24.22.2`；声明的 DSH 范围为 `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`。插件不包含 Codex CLI，也不代替 Codex 账号登录。详见[支持范围](docs/installation.md#支持范围)。

当前版本为 **`0.5.3-beta` 预发行版**。以下命令固定安装此版本；npm 的 `next` 标签随新的预发行版更新。

已收录至 DSH Market 使用的社区目录。可打开[插件详情页](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/halftin/dsh-codex-runner/)，或在 DSH Market 搜索 `dsh-codex-runner`；当前目录条目提供 `0.5.3-beta` 发行包。

dsh-codex-runner README · 下载与安装：| 获取方式 | 入口 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| npm 包 | [dsh-codex-runner](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-codex-runner) | `0.5.3-beta`（`next` 渠道） |
| `.tgz` 插件包 | [下载 0.5.3-beta](https://github.com/halftin/dsh-codex-runner/releases/download/v0.5.3-beta/dsh-codex-runner-0.5.3-beta.tgz) | 预构建插件包 |
| GitHub 仓库 | [halftin/dsh-codex-runner](https://github.com/halftin/dsh-codex-runner) | `main` 为开发分支 |

**通过 DSH 界面安装：** 打开“插件 → 添加插件”，填写以下地址，安装后按提示启用插件或重启 DSH

```text
dsh-codex-runner@0.5.3-beta
```

dsh-codex-runner README · 下载与安装：**通过 CLI 安装：** 将 `<profile>` 替换为实际使用的 DSH profile

```text
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-codex-runner@0.5.3-beta
```

已有 `.tgz` 文件时，也可以直接安装本地包：

```text
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-codex-runner-0.5.3-beta.tgz
```

也可填写 `github:halftin/dsh-codex-runner#v0.5.3-beta` 安装此版本的源码。`main` 会随开发更新，`next` 会随新的预发布版本更新；上述命令固定安装 `0.5.3-beta`。通过 DSH 安装插件即可，无需另行执行 `npm install`。环境检查、可执行文件路径、安装排查和卸载方法见[安装文档](docs/installation.md)

dsh-codex-runner README · 开始使用：1. 在终端执行 `codex login`，完成 Codex 登录
2. 在 DSH 中选择项目工作区，运行 `codex_doctor()` 检查连接，再用 `codex_models()` 查看可用模型
3. 将任务交给 DSH，说明目标、范围和验收要求；默认使用设置中的模型和思考强度；开启自主选档后再显式提供

例如，可以向 DSH 提出：

> 请使用 Codex 修复当前项目中的这个问题，先确认可用模型和思考强度，再执行任务、运行相关检查并复查结果

需要直接调用工具时，可参考以下示例，将占位符替换为实际值：

```text
codex_run(prompt_file="task.md", label="task", detach=true)
codex_status(run_id="<返回的运行 ID>")
codex_say(run_id="<运行 ID>", action="steer", message="补充要求")
codex_cancel(run_id="<运行 ID>")

dsh-codex-runner README · 开始使用：`task.md` 是当前工作区中写好的任务文件。每次执行会返回唯一运行 ID，后续可准确查询、追加指令或取消。「DSH 自主选模型与推理强度」默认关闭，运行直接使用设置里的默认模型与默认推理强度；开启后由 DSH 按任务明确选择并传入 `model` 与 `effort`；关闭时必须省略这两个参数

完整工具列表、读取会话、任务续跑和状态含义见[工具与任务操作](docs/tools.md)

dsh-codex-runner README · 修改设置：打开 DSH 中该插件的详情页，修改设置后点击底部固定的 **保存** 按钮

| 设置内容 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| 模型与思考强度 | 默认模型与推理强度；开启自主选档后由 DSH 按任务选择 |
| 实时显示与主动监督 | 分别控制聊天记录显示和 DSH 主动处理进展；后者消耗模型 token |
| 沙箱与审批 | 控制 Codex 任务的访问权限和审批方式 |
| 低额度暂停与自动恢复 | 按需向 Codex 发送暂停或续跑消息，会产生额外模型 token 消耗 |
| 定时查询 Codex 状态 | 让 DSH 定期查询并报告进展，会消耗 DSH 模型 token |
| 高级设置 | 管理并发、历史保留、调试记录和本机 CLI 路径 |

高级设置末尾的 **编辑完整配置与注册表** 提供表格、注册表 JSON、配置 JSON 三个页签。它们共用编辑草稿，点击保存后才写入对应配置；刷新注册表会独立更新参考缓存

dsh-codex-runner README · 修改设置：设置页与配置 JSON 共用当前 DSH profile。保存后的执行参数用于后续任务，已经启动的 Codex 任务保留启动参数；实时显示开关保存后立即生效。插件界面跟随 DSH 的中英文语言设置。

配置优先级、默认值、编辑器保存规则及 token 开销说明见[配置与注册表](docs/configuration.md)

dsh-codex-runner README · 模型选档 Beta：「DSH 自主选模型与推理强度」默认关闭：新任务使用设置里的默认模型与默认推理强度，DSH 不参与选档，也不能传 model/effort。开启后由 DSH 根据任务目标事前明确选择；预设选档策略默认关闭，此时不使用任务类型或证据规则，只有选择仅审计或强制执行才启用策略。策略从属于主开关，策略关闭时其下控件不显示。额度将满、成本或等待时间不能成为擅自降档的理由。自动额度恢复沿用原任务记录的模型和推理强度，并重新检查当前可用模型、策略和权限；默认档位变化不会让续跑静默换档。预设规则仍为 Beta，不承诺复杂度判断准确率或额度节省

dsh-codex-runner README · 运行原理：```mermaid
flowchart LR
    User["用户"] <--> DSH["DSH：规划与验收"]
    DSH <--> Plugin["插件：启动、监测与控制"]
    Plugin <--> Codex["Codex CLI：本地工作区执行"]

插件通过 Codex App Server 或兼容 CLI 驱动执行任务。启动、进程监测、状态查询和本地记录由代码处理，不为这些机械操作单独调用模型；Codex 执行任务、DSH 复查结果及处理通知仍会产生相应模型用量

一次执行结束不等于用户目标已经完成，结果仍由 DSH 复查。提示词按 DSH 提交内容发送；执行记录保存在当前工作区，插件不复制登录凭据，也不自动回滚项目改动

额度恢复、通知、数据保留和故障排查见[运行说明](docs/runtime.md)

dsh-codex-runner README · dsh-codex-runner：**dsh-codex-runner** is a Windows DSH plugin for delegating project tasks to the local Codex CLI and managing their execution and results. Codex uses your local workspace and existing login; DSH handles planning, review, and follow-up work

dsh-codex-runner README · What you can do：| Your goal | Plugin capability |
| --- | --- |
| Delegate project work to Codex | Start tasks in the current workspace and receive complete final answers |
| Run long tasks | Execute in the background, then query or cancel by run ID after a DSH restart |
| Add instructions during execution | Steer or interrupt the current turn, or queue a follow-up |
| Inspect progress and history | Query execution status, account quota, and associated workspace sessions |
| Watch output during execution | Both backends show prose and expandable operations in the chat flow without model calls for display |
| Let DSH supervise | Read progress in batches, answer original requests, and adjust the same task within existing authorization |
| Manage permissions and configuration | Use native settings, a full configuration editor, and an editable field registry |
| Enable optional enhancements | Choose quota pauses, recovery, and periodic status reports with explicit token-cost descriptions |

dsh-codex-runner README · What you can do：Live display and supervision are independently enabled by default. Both App Server and exec show completed messages and operations as separate chat records and catch up after reconnection. Continuous output queries stop once a task ends and its output is drained. Display alone makes no model calls; supervision consumes DSH model tokens and automatically detaches new runs when the host supports it. See [Runtime](docs/runtime.en.md).

dsh-codex-runner README · Download and install：Requires **Windows, DSH, and an installed, authenticated Codex CLI**. Node `22.23.4` is the minimum; `22.23.4` and `24.22.2` have been tested. The declared DSH range is `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`. The plugin does not bundle Codex CLI or handle account login. See [Supported environment](docs/installation.en.md#supported-environment).

Version **`0.5.3-beta`** is a prerelease. The commands below pin this version; npm `next` tracks newer prereleases.

dsh-codex-runner README · Get started：`task.md` is a task file you have written in the current workspace. Each execution returns a unique run ID for subsequent queries, instructions, or cancellation. "Let DSH choose model and reasoning effort" is off by default, so runs use the configured default model and effort; enable it to have DSH choose and pass `model` and `effort` per task. Omit both parameters while it is off

dsh-codex-runner README · Change settings：Open the plugin's detail page in DSH, change the controls, then click **Save** in the fixed bottom bar

dsh-codex-runner README · Change settings：| Settings | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Model and reasoning effort | Defaults used when DSH autonomy is off; DSH picks per task when enabled |
| Live display and supervision | Control chat record display and active DSH supervision separately; supervision consumes model tokens |
| Sandbox and approval | Control Codex access permissions and approval behavior |
| Low-quota pause and recovery | Optionally send pause/resume messages, with additional model-token usage |
| Periodic Codex status queries | Ask DSH to check and report progress, consuming DSH model tokens |
| Advanced settings | Manage concurrency, history retention, debug recording, and local CLI paths |

dsh-codex-runner README · Change settings：**Edit full configuration and registry** at the end of Advanced settings opens Table, Registry JSON, and Configuration JSON tabs. They share an editing draft; Save writes the corresponding configuration. Refresh registry independently updates the reference cache

dsh-codex-runner README · Change settings：Controls and configuration JSON share the current DSH profile. Saved execution parameters apply to subsequent tasks; an already launched Codex task retains its launch parameters. Live display switches take effect immediately after saving. The interface follows DSH's Chinese/English language selection.

See [Configuration and registry](docs/configuration.en.md) for defaults, precedence, save behavior, and token costs

dsh-codex-runner README · Model selection beta："Let DSH choose model and reasoning effort" is off by default: new tasks use the configured default model and default reasoning effort, and DSH neither selects nor may pass model/effort. When enabled, DSH chooses explicitly from the task. The preset selection policy is off by default (no task-kind or evidence rules); only audit or enforce activates it. The policy is subordinate to the main switch, and its controls are hidden while the policy is off. Quota, cost and waiting time must not cause unilateral downgrades. Automatic quota recovery retains the original recorded model and effort and checks current model availability, policy, and permissions; changing defaults does not silently change the resumed task's selection. Preset rules remain beta, without proven complexity-classification accuracy or quota savings

dsh-codex-runner README · How it works：```mermaid
flowchart LR
    User["User"] <--> DSH["DSH: planning and acceptance"]
    DSH <--> Plugin["Plugin: execution, monitoring, control"]
    Plugin <--> Codex["Codex CLI: local workspace"]

The plugin runs tasks through Codex App Server or a compatibility CLI driver. Process management, status queries, and local records run in code without separate model calls. Codex task execution, DSH review, and notification handling still use the relevant models

dsh-codex-runner README · How it works：An execution ending does not establish that the user's goal is complete; DSH reviews the outcome. Prompts are sent as submitted by DSH. Records stay in the workspace, credentials are not copied, and project changes are not automatically rolled back

See [Runtime, quota, and troubleshooting](docs/runtime.en.md) for recovery, notifications, retention, and diagnostics
